verdict.rationale: Canva's first-party docs describe an official MCP server and AI Connector that let users operate Canva through natural language from their own AI assistants. Documented capabilities include text-to-design generation, targeted design edits via natural-language commands, search and discovery, export and resize, asset and brand management, and comments. A probe also confirms the MCP docs exist. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works as claimed, and detail on Canva's native in-editor AI commands (only a thin Canva AI mention); some tools are also gated to Pro and above.
